description: Complete Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool declarations for NanoFile Desktop
title: NanoFile MCP Tools Specification

tools.description: Unified high-performance item search across files and directories. Supports item_type (all, file, folder) and extensions filter.

directory_path.description: Target folder path if scope is 'directory'.

max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return, default 50

mode.description: Search mode: 'turbo' (in-memory fast index), 'realtime' (live disk scan), or 'auto' (follow application state). Defaults to 'auto'.

query.description: The search keyword or name fragment

scope.description: Search scope: 'common' (frequently used locations like Desktop, Documents, Downloads), 'global' (all drives), or 'directory' (specific target folder). Defaults to 'common'.

item_type.description: Item type filter: all, file, or folder.

tools.name: search_items

tools.description: Perform safe lifecycle operations on a file or folder: move, copy, rename, or recycle (move to Trash).

source_path.description: Absolute path to source file or folder

target_path.description: Destination path or new name (required for move, copy, rename)

tools.name: operate_item

tools.description: Perform batch lifecycle operations on multiple files or folders: move, copy, or recycle.

destination_directory.description: Target folder for move or copy operations

tools.name: batch_operate_items

tools.description: Read the UTF-8 text content of a specified file with optional character limit.
tools.name: read_file_content

tools.description: Create or overwrite a file with UTF-8 text content.
tools.name: write_file_content

tools.description: Open a file using system default program or specified application.

with_app.description: Optional path or executable name of the app to launch with

tools.name: open_file

tools.description: Get the default open application for a specific file extension or file path.

extension_or_path.description: File extension (e.g. '.pdf', 'txt') or full file path

tools.name: get_file_default_app

tools.description: Set the default opening application for a specific file extension.

app_path.description: Executable path or registered application name

tools.name: set_file_default_app

tools.description: List the direct contents of a folder with size and type info.

include_hidden.description: Whether to list hidden items (default false)

tools.name: list_folder_contents

tools.description: Create a directory recursively at the specified path.
tools.name: create_folder

tools.description: Get the default opening application/handler configured for directories.
tools.name: get_folder_default_app

tools.description: Set the default opening application or tool for opening directories (e.g. 'nanofile', 'explorer', 'terminal', or custom app path).

app.description: Application identifier: 'nanofile', 'explorer', 'terminal', or an executable path

tools.name: set_folder_default_app

tools.description: Open or reveal a folder using the default configured application or explicitly specified target (nanofile, explorer, terminal, or custom app).

target.description: Optional open target ('default', 'nanofile', 'explorer', 'terminal', or executable path)

tools.name: open_folder

tools.description: List all existing custom tags across the system along with their usage counts.
tools.name: list_all_tags

tools.description: Remove a tag entirely from the tag catalog and unbind it from all associated files/folders.
tools.name: delete_tag

tools.description: Rename an existing tag across the catalog and update all associated items.
tools.name: rename_tag

tools.description: Get assigned custom tags for a specific file or folder.
tools.name: get_item_tags

tools.description: Assign or update custom tags for a file or folder.
tools.name: set_item_tags

tools.description: Remove specific tags or all tags from a file or folder.

tags.description: Tags to remove. If omitted, removes all tags.

tools.name: remove_item_tags

tools.description: Get file or folder metadata including size, permissions, timestamps, and item/file count for directories.
tools.name: get_item_metadata

tools.description: Get detailed inspection info for media or documents (extension, lines/chars for text).
tools.name: get_media_metadata

tools.description: Search installed desktop applications by name keyword.
tools.name: search_apps

tools.description: Launch an installed application with optional arguments.
tools.name: launch_app

tools.description: Open the system uninstaller or Settings page for an application.

app_name.description: Name of the application to uninstall

tools.name: uninstall_app

tools.description: List all bookmarked favorite directories and quick access locations.
tools.name: get_favorites

tools.description: Add a folder path to favorites/quick access.
tools.name: add_favorite

tools.description: Remove a folder path from favorites.
tools.name: remove_favorite
